info.title: CodeTorch.Agent.Cli
info.description: CodeTorch Agent CLI (cta) - Command-line tool for agent operations including dev slot deployments, status checks, and verification.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: CodeTorch Agent CLI - Deploy to preview slots

commands.name: devslot
commands.description: Manage dev slot deployments

commands.name: claim
commands.description: Claim dev slots for a task

options.name: --task
options.description: The task ID to claim slots for

options.name: --app
options.description: Repeatable key=prefix pair from codetorch.yaml preview.apps[], e.g. --app "api=Tenant API Slot" --app "portal=Tenant Portal Slot". Preferred over --prefixes.

options.name: --prefixes
options.description: DEPRECATED. Comma-separated list of slot prefixes. The backend derives the app key from the prefix's first word which produces ambiguous keys for multi-word prefixes. Use --app instead.

commands.name: release
commands.description: Release dev slots claimed by a task

options.name: --task
options.description: The task ID to release slots for

options.name: --task

options.name: --workspace
